questions.title: Will the fuel loading of the Palisades Nuclear Generating Station's reactor core be completed before December 16, 2026?
questions.background:
The Nation: [Is America Headed Toward a New “Nuclear Golden Age”?](https://www.thenation.com/article/environment/nuclear-power-palisades-michigan-holtec/)

`{"format": "bot_tournament_question", "info": {"hash_id": "b8d8fbf7df7449d9", "sheet_id": "150"}}`
questions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if, before December 16, 2026, according to credible sources such as Holtec International or the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, the fuel-loading milestone of the Palisades nuclear plant is completed.
